text:
tess_fin: Morning team — vendor "CloudLink AP" submitted an out-of-cycle charge INV-CL-204 for $29,875. Vendor says it's a retro tariff true-up for Jan-Feb 2026 egress. Need quick guidance on deferral vs expense and revenue impact. tagging @ellie_rev @olivia_fp&a

ellie_rev: Do we have whether those costs were passed to customers? If yes, we may need revenue adjustments; if not, it's COGS.

jeff_billing: Uploading invoice and line detail: https://drive.redwood/finance/apac/INV-CL-204.pdf. Billing note says "retroactive tariff applied to prior shipments". My initial GL staging would be 2002 Accrued-Vendor.

maria_fin: Ran a quick match across invoices — looks like about $18,200 lines map to customer pass-throughs (mostly 3 customers), remainder is internal. Putting together per-customer CSV.

olivia_fp&a: Materiality: quarter threshold is $25k. This invoice is slightly below; still document in month-end adjustments but may not require external disclosure. Confirm per-policy.

ellie_rev: Even if below disclosure threshold, we need correct schedule mapping. Please include rev_schedule_id for each customer line. If customers were invoiced in the prior period, we should create adjustment JEs rather than expense.

tess_fin: CSV uploaded: https://drive.redwood/finance/apac/INV-CL-204-breakout.csv. Quick breakout: CUST-A12 $9,000 (rev_sched 9010), CUST-B33 $5,600 (rev_sched 9011), CUST-C78 $3,600 (rev_sched 9010), internal absorption $11,675.

billing-bot: INV-CL-204 entered in AP staging under vendor CloudLink AP. Suggested tag: "retro-trueup".

jeff_billing: Draft JE proposal (preview):
Dr 4110 AR - Customer invoices issued     $18,200.00
Dr 2002 Accrued-Expense (internal)        $11,675.00
Cr 4000 Revenue - Usage Pass-through       $18,200.00
Dr 6000 COGS - Network                     $29,875.00
Cr 2002 Accrued-Vendor                     $29,875.00
Notes: allocate AR to existing rev schedules per CSV; we'll issue supplemental invoices where contracts permit.

ellie_rev: Approve draft in principle. Action: tess_fin to flag any single customer >$10k for FP&A lead sign-off (none here). Olivia to confirm tax on supplemental invoices. Jeff prepare credit/invoice templates. I'll add adjustment lines to month-end tracker.
\omitted: short ack messages and meeting invite coordination

tess_fin: Will finalize and route JE for approval by 15:30 PT. Thanks.
